title: Saudi Legal Corpus: verified legislation at article level, published judgments in full text, and a citator joining them
description: Two corpora for one jurisdiction, joined at the level at which a lawyer argues. The legislative side holds 15,855 verified article-level records across 291 Saudi instruments, each with its number, text, legal status and official-source provenance, together with derived analytical layers and a 519-query retrieval benchmark. The judicial side holds 50,666 judgments published in full text by the Ministry of Justice, of which 15,383 carry the appellate decision as well as the first-instance one. A citator links the two: 99,158 statutory citations matched to the article cited, each carrying the segment of the judgment it sits in, whether the court or a party is speaking, and whether that judgment survived appeal. This release is not an official government publication, does not provide legal advice, and is not a substitute for the official Arabic texts published by the competent authorities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The official Arabic text governs in all cases.
